author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Reads as a knife carving into a bowl, with a shaving curling out, at 48 in both themes; composition follows the reference.
omissions: The bowl foot is omitted (no height under a deep bowl). The wood shaving is a single hook, since a spiral needs 9-unit turn spacing. The blade tip rests on the rim instead of dipping into the bowl, because a crossing is not allowed.
